{"kind":"effect-plugin","definition":{"id":"effect.affix.kunheng-earth-ward","name":"镇域","kind":"affix","scope":"aura","version":2,"description":"携带镇域的飞剑周围4米内，友方单位增加词条所示的土行抗性点数。同名只取圈内最强，离圈失效；停发驻身仍可护持，飞剑自身不获得此属性。","iconGuid":"61affd9f-4849-57f9-89d8-cfefb84ba4a6","families":["survival.kunheng-earth-ward"],"mechanism":{"kind":"affix","parameters":{"stat":"auraStrength","operation":"flat","scopeByKind":{"weapon":"aura"},"eligibility":{"id":"affix.roll.kunheng-earth-ward","name":"镇域","systems":["returning-sword"],"introducedInPoolVersion":3,"definitionVersion":1,"balanceVersion":1,"comparableRuleVersion":1,"slot":"suffix","unit":"points","stat":"auraStrength","operation":"flat","visualSignal":"rune","consumer":{"capability":"aura-skills","version":3},"recordPolicy":"higher","allowedKinds":["weapon"],"poolKinds":["weapon"],"poolFamilies":["returning-melee"],"scopeByKind":{"weapon":"aura"},"minRarity":4,"minimumItemLevel":1,"selectionWeight":0.45,"budgetCost":14,"maximumEffectiveValue":26,"conflicts":[],"auraSkillGuid":"51832aef-0502-5868-b2ea-329d9aa04836"},"sourceDomain":{"effectiveUsage":"player","modules":["returning-sword"],"boards":[],"ownerChain":[],"purePresentation":false,"ordinaryAvailability":"module-gated","moduleEvidence":"坤衡与镇岳主击分别明确准入同一共享镇域；未列入的武器仍拒绝，土行伤害不自动授予光环。"}}},"strength":[{"field":"value","label":"圈内友方土行抗性点数","formula":{"kind":"affix-range","definitionId":"affix.roll.kunheng-earth-ward","baseValue":9,"valuePerTier":1.2,"operation":"flat","unit":"点","levels":{"min":1,"max":100,"kind":"integer"}}}],"relations":{"defaultWeight":0,"familyRules":[],"targetOverrides":[{"targetId":"effect.houtu-returning-sword.continuous-returning-strike","weight":0.55,"reason":"镇岳厚岩防线可以携带同一镇域；只有真实位于来源飞剑4米内的友方单位得到土抗，重压和低飞不保证主人留在圈内。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.canopy","weight":0.25,"reason":"青荫提高圈内护甲与灵抗，镇域增加土抗点数；防护层和各自距离分开计算，不互乘词值或扩大半径。"},{"targetId":"effect.houtu-returning-sword.heavy-pressure","weight":0,"reason":"重压不增加镇域点数、半径或覆盖；必带工序不作为第二份取得亲和。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix
